name: revise
description: Proofread and revise your text with your own Revise writing rules, and review every suggested change before you use it.

interface.longDescription:
Revise is a writing assistant that proofreads and polishes your text using your own writing rules.

Paste a draft into ChatGPT and ask Revise to check it. Revise applies one of your saved rules (Proofread, Grammar Check, Naturalize, Concise, or any custom rule you created in Revise) and shows the result in an interactive card:

- Every suggested change is highlighted inline, so you can see exactly what changed.
- Accept or reject each change one by one, or all at once.
- Ask why a change was made and get a short explanation.
- Send the final text back to the chat, or save it to your Revise workspace to keep editing.

Revise keeps your formatting, including paragraphs and line breaks, and works in many languages.

You need a Revise account to use this app. Sign in once when you connect it, and your rules and documents stay in sync with the Revise web app and Chrome extension.
capabilities: Proofread and revise text with your saved writing rules
Review, accept or reject each suggested change
Explain why a change was made
Save revised text to your Revise workspace
defaultPrompt: Proofread this with Revise: I has went to the store yesterday and buyed three apple.
Show me my Revise writing rules
Make this more concise with Revise: I just wanted to quickly reach out to let you all know the meeting moved.

positive.prompt: Proofread this with Revise: Their going to the libary tomorow, and they has alot of books to return.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls revise_text with the text. The Revise card shows the changes highlighted (They're, library, tomorrow, have, a lot) and the assistant gives a short summary.

positive.prompt: What writing rules do I have in Revise?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_rules and lists the rules saved in the user's Revise account, such as Proofread, Grammar Check, Naturalize and Concise.

positive.prompt: Use my Revise Concise rule on this: I just wanted to quickly reach out to let you all know that the meeting has been moved to Friday.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls revise_text with rule_name Concise (optionally after list_rules). The card shows a shorter version with the removed words highlighted.

positive.prompt: Why did Revise change libary to library?
positive.expected_behavior: After a revision, calls explain_change with the original and revised spans and returns a short explanation of the spelling fix.

positive.description: Save text to the Revise workspace
positive.prompt: Save this text to Revise so I can keep editing it: Quarterly update. Sales grew 12% and we hired two new engineers.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls save_to_revise and returns a link to the new document in the user's Revise workspace.

negative.prompt: What is the capital of France?
Write me a short poem about the ocean.

review.commerce_description: Revise does not sell products or process payments in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: First release: proofread and revise text with your Revise writing rules, review each change in an interactive card, ask why a change was made, and save results to Revise.
